title: IC4SD-TrafficSnap: A City-Scale Multi-Camera Image Time-Series and Geospatial Road Network Dataset for Heterogeneous Urban Traffic
description:
IC4SD-TrafficSnap is an open-access multimodal dataset coupling 714,123 discrete surveillance camera snapshots (44.38 GiB / 47.66 GB) across 608 indexed stations in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, and OpenStreetMap-derived geospatial road network metadata. As a direct derived representation of the geospatial road layout and sequential corridor adjacency, a 608x608 directed spatial graph topology (2,450 corridors <= 6.0 km) is provided for spatio-temporal modeling.

Key Modalities & Highlights:

  • Scale & Stations: 608 active municipal camera stations across arterials and intersections in former urban districts of Ho Chi Minh City, fully mapped to geospatial coordinates and road topology.
  • Surveillance Image Time-Series: 714,123 valid 512x288 pixel JPEG snapshots acquired continuously over 93.6 hours (spanning 5 calendar days: October 2 to October 6, 2026) at an empirical polling interval of 269.0 +/- 239.7 s (median: 263.0 s).
  • Geospatial Road Network & Derived Graph: Station GPS coordinates, elevations, arterial classifications, and pairwise shortest driving distances from OpenStreetMap (OSRM v5.27.1), yielding a 608x608 directed spatial graph with 1,070 unidirectional links without reverse edges and 238 distance-asymmetric pairs.
  • Quantified Negligible Privacy Risk: High pole mounting (>6 m) and downward oblique viewing physically guarantee zero legible human faces or vehicle license plates (95% CI upper bound <= 0.0015% across 200,000 audited frames via the Rule of Three).
  • Licensing: Public academic research use for surveillance imagery and metadata; Open Database License (ODbL) for the OpenStreetMap-derived road graph; MIT License for PyTorch loaders and graph code.
